barRaise.topFinding: The codebase has not changed in a week (only commit since 2026-08-03 touched docs/GDD.html and project.godot's version pill; two independent nightly audits confirm zero source drift), yet this run found real breakage: pressing Escape does not stop the horde (three disconnected pause authorities), the canonical-state Worker accepts unauthenticated writes that flow unescaped into innerHTML, and four whole building categories are wired to economy hooks nobody calls. The wrangler deploy fix documented nine days ago as needed still hasn't run, so that break now reaches the published GDD mirror. Health fell 62 to 56 on sharper evidence of unchanged code, not new damage. The strategic-kill-this lens flagged that this very run is proof the skip-unchanged gate is miscalibrated (a docs-only commit forced a full 20-lens re-scan of a tree two audits certified unchanged), and that the undecided HBH-vs-Brackish-Rising priority call still has no ADR after being raised in the last two reviews.
